meta.name: hypogenic
meta.description: Automated LLM-driven hypothesis generation and testing on tabular datasets. Use when you want to systematically explore hypotheses about patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis). Combines literature insights with data-driven hypothesis testing. For manual hypothesis formulation use hypothesis-generation; for creative ideation use scientific-brainstorming.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成并检验数据中的假设模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地探索表格数据中的规律并验证假设。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate and test hypotheses on tabular data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore patterns in tabular data and test hypotheses.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动从表格数据中生成并测试科学假设，支持纯数据驱动、结合文献或两者联合三种方式。
howto.when: 当你需要系统探索实证数据中的模式（如欺骗检测、内容分析），并希望自动生成和验证假设时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这份用户行为数据中生成20个可测试的假设。
say.note: 使用数据驱动方法生成假设。

say.text: 结合这些论文和数据集，生成并测试关于虚假评论的假设。
say.note: 使用文献+数据集成方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate and test scientific hypotheses from tabular datasets, supporting data-driven, literature-integrated, or combined approaches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to systematically explore patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis) and automatically generate and test hypotheses.

say_en.text: Generate 20 testable hypotheses from this user behavior data.
Combine these papers and dataset to generate and test hypotheses about fake reviews.
